h: Davido's bodyguard reportedly responds when street boys interrupt the singer at an event
p: A video said to show Davido's bodyguard dealing with street boys who crowded the singer at an event has drawn reactions online. Viewers were divided over how the security team handled the moment.
more: The event and date were not clearly stated in the reports.
Davido was among the celebrities who attended Zlatan Ibile's wedding at the weekend.
